title: Delivery Status
description: Operational delivery state of a media buy package

enumDescriptions.delivering: Package is actively delivering impressions within its scheduled flight
enumDescriptions.not_delivering: Package is within its scheduled flight but has delivered zero impressions for at least one full staleness cycle
enumDescriptions.completed: Package has finished its scheduled flight
enumDescriptions.budget_exhausted: Package has spent its full allocated budget
enumDescriptions.flight_ended: Package's scheduled flight window has ended
enumDescriptions.goal_met: Package has reached its delivery goal
